message.reasoning: We need to navigate to temporary directory. In this environment, we don't know the path. Usually /tmp. We can use pwd to see current. Then cd? There's no cd tool. But we can use ls with path? The ls tool only lists current directory. There's no tool to change directory. But we can use find with path? But we need to list all files in /tmp. We can use ls with path? The ls tool signature: ls(a?: boolean). It doesn't accept path. So we can't directly list /tmp. But we can use find with path="/tmp" to list all files. That will list all files recursively. But we want to list all files in /tmp including hidden. find will list all. Let's use find with path="/tmp" and name=None. That will return all items. Then we can display. Let's do that.
